21.15 Label observables under restriction to two groups of
copies
The subgroup dimension inequalities of [ Ope26b, Lemma 6.1(4)] give matrix inequalities for the
logarithmic label observables. These are used in Section 7 to compare whole-copy and subgroup
labels before measuring an excitation component.
